content: Would you please tell me why you want to work in our kindergarten? You know kids are sometimes so tiresome.
I love children. I can sing to them and teach them how to dance.
Then you have worked in a kindergarten before?
No, but I used to take care of children during summer and winter holidays.
I see, by the way do you want to work part time or full time?
I'm free every afternoon, so I can work about 20 hours a week.
Ok, Gene you're hired. You can work here from 2:00 PM to 6:00 PM four days a week, Monday to Thursday.
